description: This file defines a React component named ProtectedRoute that guards routes or components, ensuring only authenticated users (specifically admins) can access them. It uses context for authentication state and renders fallback components if the user is not authenticated or while loading.

methods.name: ProtectedRoute({ children, fallback = null })
methods.description: React functional component that checks user authentication status and conditionally renders children, a loading indicator, or fallback content.
